admin0RelationOverride.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: non-sovereign territories and disputed places are in scope. Sint Maarten (SX) is a territory, not a sovereign state (a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands). In OpenStreetMap the only relation carrying ISO3166-1=SX is relation 1231790 (admin_level 3); it is boundary=administrative with admin_level 3, not 2, because the territory sits below or beside a sovereign state, so the default admin-0 rule (boundary=administrative, admin_level=2) finds none. Game venue map only: no claims about real operations, borders or sovereignty; OSM mapped boundary, not legal-border authority. Every other proof (member ways, area assembly, segment match) still applies.
